lines.1: It may only be May, but it's already pretty hot this morning.
lines.2: School switched to summer uniforms last week, too.
lines.4: The obvious conclusion: leave without her.
lines.5: My school is a ten-minute walk from home. I picked it because it was close and academically decent.
lines.6: 「Hey, wait up---------! You're forgetting something way too important!」
lines.7: One idiot shot past me like a bullet with a whoosh.
lines.9: 「Me! Me! How can you forget me?!」
lines.10: Crab started smacking me over and over.
lines.11: 「Hah, hah... I was rocking out to Dead this morning and lost track of time. (That's 'morning Dead': listening to a Dead CD in the morning.)」
lines.12: 「A girl your age shouldn't pant with her tongue hanging out like a dog. It's unseemly.」
lines.13: 「You've got some nerve saying that when you're the one who left me behind!」
lines.14: 「You should be grateful I wake you up at all.」
lines.15: I wish Subaru would wake her up, too.
lines.16: But this moron insists on sleeping to the absolute last second, so the job ended up falling to me.
lines.17: 「Grr... Waking me up isn't over until I open the door, flash you a cute smile, and give you a refreshing 'Morning!' Don't slack off halfway!」
lines.18: 「Who do you think you are? You're only a Crab.」
lines.19: I gave her cheek a long, hard pull.
lines.21: She started thrashing around, so I let go.
lines.23: 「You cry pretty easily, don't you? All I did was pull your cheek and you're already tearing up.」
lines.25: 「And what a greeting first thing in the morning. I've committed this pain to memory!」
lines.27: So she was crying after all.
lines.28: 「You pick on me a lot, you know. Are you the type who can't be honest with the girl he likes?」
lines.29: 「I'm not picking on you. I'm training you.」
lines.30: She's noisy. Time to shut her up.
lines.31: 「Crab, let's have a tongue-twister contest. The red leather one.」
lines.32: 「No way! I'm bad at tongue twisters and you know it!」
lines.34: 「Hey... Didn't elementary school teach you that ignoring people gets brought up at the end-of-day class meeting?!」
lines.35: 「Red leather, yellow leather, Kinu's a loser.」
lines.36: 「Whoa... You actually said it. You're weirdly impressive, Leo.」
lines.38: 「Urk... yed lether, re--red, red lether, yeller?!」
lines.39: 「Owowowow! My tongue! I bit my tongue!」
lines.41: That ought to keep her quiet for a while.
lines.43: 「Oh, I'm gonna grab some juice at the convenience store. Wait for me, okay?」
lines.45: 「Wait! Even a dog knows how to stay!」
lines.46: 「You get mad so easily... You're short, and petty to match.」
lines.47: 「My height has nothing to do with it! Nothing!」
lines.49: 「Who cares? Let's just drift lazily through life.」
lines.50: 「Don't drag me into your Society of Hopeless Losers.」
lines.51: 「I know why you don't want to be late. We have morning assembly today, so you get to hear the Student Council President's super-cool speech.」
lines.52: 「You want to see your beloved Princess giving her speech, don't you?」
lines.54: 「Grr... Y-you're already smacking me! L-look here. I've got a lump!」
lines.55: 「What? Did I hit you that hard? Where?」
lines.58: She smelled kind of nice, and it distracted me for just a second.
lines.59: 「Now I'm mad! I was only walking to school with you out of pity! I'm never going to school with you again!」
lines.61: Crab sprinted away, her skirt riding the absolute limit of decency without showing her panties.
lines.62: 「Tch... That hurt... Your head's rock-hard for something with nothing inside it.」
lines.63: 「You and Crab are as noisy as ever.」
